b.x: In a blackout, a crowd, a street that has turned, gear fails after the head. Whoever does not know if they freeze chooses badly. Whoever does not read the polite ask takes polite for safe. Whoever lacks the right tool improvises with the body — and the body tires.
Moving without being the poster. Not invisible: boring on purpose, hard to describe later.
Cooper: relaxed and on. You know the exit, who came in, the room’s rhythm. It is not anxiety.
The normal rhythm of that place at that hour. What matters is the deviation — not the face.
In unrest, the edge still has a choice. The core does not. Whoever enters the core becomes mass.
The family pact if we split. One place, one deadline. It is not ‘we’ll find each other’.
The path to the street that does not cross the center of the scene. Seen in the first five seconds.
The phone light dies with the battery and occupies a hand. A pocket torch frees the other hand and does not light your face.
Thirst decides badly in less than a day. Three liters per person per day at home; on the street, what fits without advertising.
Ten blocks on foot, glass, mud, stairs. The ugly house trainers are worth more than the combat boot in the window.
The card machine dies in a blackout. A wad draws eyes. Small notes buy bread, water, a fare without a speech.
The set is a map, a bad light, a contact, and emergency numbers. A short cable and a small bank save the long day.
Hospital, shelter, police, a ticket. Without paper, you become a case — not a person.
